name: @amykit/plugin-command
description: Any command line tool, reached by a name the config allows.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when a workflow or a proof needs a command line tool, such as a monitoring CLI. It mounts the commands port and the run-command action, and runs only the command lines written in its allow list, by name: a workflow may pass arguments and never the line itself. The prove workflow uses it to bring the resources a scenario runs against up and down, and to print the digest of the code a proof certifies.
